trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks across all production regions with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. ✅ Rolled back checkout-api from v2.3.1 → **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west)
2. ✅ Verified recovery — service is now healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%
3. ✅ Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the health check failures and the rollback

**Note:** Since v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, any future redeploy of that version will require change-manager approval per organizational policy.
